died.name: Genghis Khan
died.last_words: Let not my end disarm you, and on no account weep or keen for me, lest the enemy be warned of my death.

died.name: Pope Alexander VI
died.last_words: All right, all right, I'm coming. Wait a moment.

died.name: Honoré de Balzac
died.cause: written across the bottom of a letter from his wife
died.last_words: I can no longer read or write. De Balzac.

died.name: François Xavier Aubry
died.cause: mortally wounded in saloon fight by Richard Hanson Weightman

died.name: Alexandru Șerbănescu
died.desc: Second World War Romanian fighter ace

died.name: Chris McCandless
died.cause: final note written before dying of starvation
died.last_words: I HAVE HAD A HAPPY LIFE AND THANK THE LORD. GOODBYE AND MAY GOD BLESS ALL!

died.name: Sylvester Lewis Adams
died.cause: prior to execution by lethal injection
died.last_words: I'm the happiest man in the world! I'm not afraid to die! I'm not crazy! I'm going to be reaching that white house tonight!

born.name: Meriwether Lewis
born.last_words: I am not coward, but I am so strong. It is hard to die.
